verification.stimulus: Validate both protocol source-byte pins, the historical frozen package pin, the shared active-package locator, all three execution and quarantine bindings, then resolve absent, explicit-candidate, historical, explicit-default, and unknown selector inputs.
verification.expectedSemanticState: An absent selector resolves to executable protocol v1 on the active package and its v2 quarantine contract; historical v1 is routed to its matching frozen package and v1 quarantine contract; protocol 2.x remains contract-only and resolves only by its explicit candidate identifier; and active bindings avoid a circular projection digest.

verification.forbiddenMutation: The test must not select historical compatibility for new work, rewrite either protocol, embed a circular active package digest, or migrate a historical session.
